description: Round-2 fixup, Phase 4 — post-break anchor: spanning Normal-mode Loop clip resumes from where the user was watching at GO, not from the natural clipStart-derived mapping. 30fps timeline, single Loop clip on track 0 starting at frame 0, duration 240. Source asset gradient_seq has 16 frames so Loop wraps modulo 16. Natural mapping at post-GO frame 62 = 62 % 16 = 14 (and would be 14 regardless of how the at-break advance unfolds, since natural path discards phase). Anchor mapping = (anchor + delta) % 16 where anchor reflects the actual source frame the user saw at GO; with at-break pause advancing phase past 60 source-frames, anchor ends up well away from 13 (which would otherwise post-GO to 14). The two assertions: (a) post-GO playhead is at frame 62 and state is Playing — proves SectionGo did its job end-to-end; (b) post-GO mediaFrame is NOT the natural value 14 — proves the anchor branch is steering. Detailed anchor math (Loop/PingPong wrap correctness, multi-break re-seed, scrub reset) is covered by tests/unit/PostBreakAnchorTests.cpp; this script is the end-to-end smoke that wires Director's GO state machine into the per-tick mapping.
